build_mnist_dataset: build a python module to load the MNIST dataset with train or test split from data_root
build_fashionmnist_dataset: build a python module to load the FashionMNIST dataset with train or test split from data_root
read_sn3_tensor: read a SN3 Pascal Vincent format tensor file and return a torch.Tensor with proper dtype
read_label_file: read labels from an SN3 label file and return a long tensor of ground truth labels
read_image_file: read images from an SN3 image file and return a 3D uint8 tensor of image data
